manager_rule: When emitting the absorber_exclusion_broken halt payload required by Rule 8, the payload MUST additionally include field (f): the complete per-net unconnected list retrieved from the FR/DRC scoring artifacts for the triggering round — not merely the net names that appear in gate-failure failing_reasons — with each entry annotated as either a /SENSEC*_HI or /SENSEC*_LO net (Kelvin class) or a non-Kelvin net. This augments Rule 8's required fields (a)–(e) and is mandatory for every halt: it allows the human reviewer to determine whether the unidentified unconnected ratlines are themselves Kelvin nets that the absorber consumed and left unrouted (which widens the scope of the required code fix) or are separate routing failures (which may indicate an independent issue requiring a separate corrective action beyond the absorber exclusion-list fix). If the full per-net unconnected list cannot be retrieved from the scoring artifacts at halt time, this retrieval failure must itself be logged in the halt payload as 'unconnected_list_unavailable' and treated as an additional blocking condition: human authorization to resume must explicitly acknowledge the incomplete payload and authorize resumption despite the missing data.
